member.name: T:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram
member.summary: Runs a ComfyUI workflow from the command line. The input and output types are generated from the workflow (ComfyUiTypeGenerator) and compiled at runtime (Roslyn), the input type inherits ComfyUiParams so its members (the connection parameters and the workflow inputs) are the command line options.

member.name: F:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.ExitRunFailed
member.summary: Exit code: running the workflow failed (connection, server or workflow error, cancelled).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.ExitNoResults
member.summary: Exit code: the workflow returned no results.

member.name: T:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.BufferedMessages
member.summary: Keeps messages to show them later (or not)

member.name: M:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.BufferedMessages.Replay(SysWeaver.IMessageHost,SysWeaver.MessageLevels)
member.summary: Add the kept messages with at least some level to a message host (once)

member.name: M:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.FindWorkflowFile(System.String[])
member.summary: The workflow file: the first argument that is an existing .json file

member.name: M:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.ParseConnection(System.String[])
member.summary: Parse the connection options (the options of ComfyUiParams) only, all other arguments are ignored

member.name: M:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.GetFileNames(System.Collections.Generic.List{System.ValueTuple{System.Byte[],System.String,System.String}},System.String,System.String)
member.summary: The file names of the results. An existing folder (or a name ending with a separator): new files named after the workflow (and the output tag if there are several outputs), with the extension of the result. Else a file name (the extension of the result is added if it has none): the first result is saved to it, other results to new files named after it.

member.name: M:SysWeaver.RunComfyUiProgram.Unique(System.String,System.String,System.String)
member.summary: A file name that doesn't exist: "stem.ext", else "stem_2.ext", "stem_3.ext" etc

member.name: T:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes
member.summary: The runtime (Roslyn compiled) input and output types of a workflow. The input type inherits ComfyUiParams, so its members are both the connection parameters and the workflow inputs (used as command line options).

member.name: F:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.Output
member.summary: The output type, each member is a List<byte[]> (all results of an output)

member.name: F:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.Outputs
member.summary: The outputs: the member of the output type, the output tag and the guessed file extension (from the output node)

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.Create(SysWeaver.AI.ComfyUiWorkflow,SysWeaver.IMessageHost)
member.summary: Create the types of a workflow

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.LoadAssembly(System.String)
member.summary: Compile the source (or use a cached compilation), the assembly and its xml documentation are written to a cache folder so that the documentation is found for the command line help (SysWeaver.Docs reads "Assembly.xml" next to the assembly)

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.GetOutputs(SysWeaver.AI.ComfyUiWorkflow,System.Type)
member.summary: The output members, their tags and guessed extensions

member.name: M:SysWeaver.WorkflowTypes.GuessExtension(System.Text.Json.JsonElement,System.String)
member.summary: Guess the file extension of an output from its node(s): a "format" like input (ex: "png", "video/h264-mp4"), else the node class (ex: "SaveAudioMP3", "SaveVideo")
